<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_LANParty"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Invitation" name="LAN party invitation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GameList" name="List of desired games"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DateProposal" name="Proposed date"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Availability" name="Date availability responses"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LANParty">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Planner" name="LAN party planner" processRef="Process_LANParty"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="10 friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation" name="Send invitations" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GameList" name="Provide desired games" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGameList" messageRef="Message_GameList"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateProposal" name="Share proposed date" sourceRef="Task_SendDateProposal" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_DateProposal"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Availability" name="Respond about availability" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAvailability" messageRef="Message_Availability"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="Plan LAN party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Plan" name="Planning begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Invitations</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends" messageRef="Message_Invitation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Invitations</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Invitations_GameList</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveGameList" name="Receive list of desired games" messageRef="Message_GameList">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Invitations_GameList</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GameList_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Find date and check games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GameList_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_AppointDate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_CheckGames</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_AppointDate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DateNotEnough_AppointDate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AppointDate_SendProposal</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDateProposal" name="Share proposed date" messageRef="Message_DateProposal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AppointDate_SendProposal</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendProposal_ReceiveAvailability</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAvailability" name="Receive availability responses" messageRef="Message_Availability">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendProposal_ReceiveAvailability</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Availability_DateDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateDecision" name="Do at least 8 people agree?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Availability_DateDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateEnough_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateNotEnough_AppointDate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateEnough_ParallelJoin" name="At least 8 agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfAgreeingFriends >= 8</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateNotEnough_AppointDate" name="Fewer than 8 agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateDecision" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGames" name="Check whether all desired games are available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_CheckGames</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckGames_GameDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GameDecision" name="Are any games missing?" default="Flow_GamesAvailable_GameMerge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckGames_GameDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesMissing_Download</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesAvailable_GameMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadGames" name="Download missing games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesMissing_Download</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Download_GameMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GameMerge" name="Continue after checking games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Download_GameMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesAvailable_GameMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GameMerge_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Date and games ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DateEnough_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GameMerge_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelJoin_CheckBeer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckBeer" name="Find out how much beer friends require">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelJoin_CheckBeer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckBeer_BeerDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerDecision" name="Is there enough beer?" default="Flow_BeerEnough_BeerMerge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckBeer_BeerDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerMissing_Buy</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerEnough_BeerMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyBeer" name="Buy missing beer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerMissing_Buy</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerMerge" name="Continue with enough beer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerEnough_BeerMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerMerge_Enjoy</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerMerge_Enjoy</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Enjoy_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PartyEnjoyed" name="LAN party enjoyed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Enjoy_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Invitations" sourceRef="StartEvent_Plan" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invitations_GameList" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGameList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GameList_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveGameList" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_AppointDate" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CheckGames" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AppointDate_SendProposal" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Task_SendDateProposal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendProposal_ReceiveAvailability" sourceRef="Task_SendDateProposal" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Availability_DateDecision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_DateDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckGames_GameDecision" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_GameDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMissing_Download" name="Games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GameDecision" targetRef="Task_DownloadGames">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">someDesiredGamesAreMissing</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesAvailable_GameMerge" name="No games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GameDecision" targetRef="Gateway_GameMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Download_GameMerge" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Gateway_GameMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GameMerge_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_GameMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_CheckBeer" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_CheckBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckBeer_BeerDecision" sourceRef="Task_CheckBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMissing_Buy" name="Beer is insufficient" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerDecision" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">beerAvailable < beerRequired</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerEnough_BeerMerge" name="Enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerDecision" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMerge_Enjoy" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enjoy_End" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyParty" targetRef="EndEvent_PartyEnjoyed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_LANParty"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Invitation" name="LAN party invitation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GameList" name="List of desired games"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DateAvailabilityRequest" name="Date availability request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DateAvailabilityResponse" name="Date availability responses"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GameList" name="Provide list of desired games" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Event_CatchGameList" messageRef="Message_GameList"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateAvailabilityRequest" name="Ask about availability on the date" sourceRef="Task_AskDateAvailability" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_DateAvailabilityRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateAvailabilityResponse" name="Respond about date availability" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Event_CatchAvailability" messageRef="Message_DateAvailabilityResponse"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="Plan LAN party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Plan" name="Planning begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Invitations</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends" messageRef="Message_Invitation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Invitations</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Invitations_GameList</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchGameList" name="Receive list of desired games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Invitations_GameList</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GameList_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_GameList" messageRef="Message_GameList"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Find a date and check the games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GameList_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_AppointDate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_CheckGames</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_AppointDate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DateNotEnough_AppointDate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AppointDate_AskAvailability</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskDateAvailability" name="Ask friends whether they can join on the date" messageRef="Message_DateAvailabilityRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AppointDate_AskAvailability</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AskAvailability_CatchAvailability</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchAvailability" name="Receive date availability responses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AskAvailability_CatchAvailability</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Availability_DateDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Availability" messageRef="Message_DateAvailabilityResponse"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateDecision" name="Do 8 or more people agree?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Availability_DateDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateEnough_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateNotEnough_AppointDate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGames" name="Check whether all requested games are available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_CheckGames</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckGames_GameDecision</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Download_GameMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesAvailable_GameMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GameMerge_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Date and games ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DateEnough_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GameMerge_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelJoin_CheckBeer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckBeer" name="Find out how much beer friends require">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelJoin_CheckBeer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckBeer_BeerDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerDecision" name="Is there enough beer?" default="Flow_BeerEnough_BeerMerge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckBeer_BeerDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerMissing_Buy</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerEnough_BeerMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyBeer" name="Buy missing beer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerMissing_Buy</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerMerge" name="Continue with enough beer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerEnough_BeerMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerMerge_Enjoy</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerMerge_Enjoy</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Enjoy_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PartyEnjoyed" name="LAN party enjoyed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Enjoy_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Invitations" sourceRef="StartEvent_Plan" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invitations_GameList" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Event_CatchGameList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GameList_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Event_CatchGameList" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_AppointDate" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CheckGames" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AppointDate_AskAvailability" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Task_AskDateAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskAvailability_CatchAvailability" sourceRef="Task_AskDateAvailability" targetRef="Event_CatchAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Availability_DateDecision" sourceRef="Event_CatchAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_DateDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateEnough_ParallelJoin" name="8 or more agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfAgreeingFriends >= 8</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateNotEnough_AppointDate" name="Fewer than 8 agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateDecision" targetRef="Task_AppointDate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfAgreeingFriends < 8</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckGames_GameDecision" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_GameDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMissing_Download" name="Some requested games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GameDecision" targetRef="Task_DownloadGames">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">someRequestedGamesAreMissing</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesAvailable_GameMerge" name="No requested games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GameDecision" targetRef="Gateway_GameMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Download_GameMerge" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Gateway_GameMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GameMerge_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_GameMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_CheckBeer" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_CheckBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckBeer_BeerDecision" sourceRef="Task_CheckBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMissing_Buy" name="Beer is insufficient" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerDecision" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">beerAvailable < beerRequired</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerEnough_BeerMerge" name="Enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerDecision" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMerge_Enjoy" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enjoy_End" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyParty" targetRef="EndEvent_PartyEnjoyed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_LANParty"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Invitation" name="LAN party invitation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GamePreferencesRequest" name="Request for game preferences"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GameList" name="List of games the friends want to play"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DateAvailabilityRequest" name="Date availability request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DateAvailabilityResponse" name="Date availability responses"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LANParty">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Planner" name="LAN party planner" processRef="Process_LANParty"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="10 friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation" name="Send invitations" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GamePreferencesRequest" name="Ask which games they want to play" sourceRef="Task_AskGamePreferences" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_GamePreferencesRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GameList" name="Provide list of games they want to play" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Event_CatchGameList" messageRef="Message_GameList"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateAvailabilityRequest" name="Ask whether they are free on the date" sourceRef="Task_AskDateAvailability" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_DateAvailabilityRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateAvailabilityResponse" name="Respond about date availability" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Event_CatchAvailability" messageRef="Message_DateAvailabilityResponse"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="Plan LAN party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Plan" name="Start planning the LAN party">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Invitations</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends" messageRef="Message_Invitation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Invitations</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Invitations_AskGamePreferences</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskGamePreferences" name="Ask which games they want to play" messageRef="Message_GamePreferencesRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Invitations_AskGamePreferences</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AskGamePreferences_CatchGameList</bpmn:outgoing>

rules.instruction: When the description says that information or a decision is requested from other participants and that the process waits for their responses before continuing: Model the wait after the request as an intermediate message catch event in the sequence flow.
rules.situation: the description says that information or a decision is requested from other participants and that the process waits for their responses before continuing

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes activities or outcomes by their action, object, recipient, or stage: Use BPMN labels that preserve those stated distinctions rather than substituting a different action or outcome.
rules.situation: the description states an activity and distinguishes it by its action or stage

rules.instruction: When the description states that multiple follow-up activities after the same point must all occur, without describing them as alternatives: Model the activities as concurrent branches using a parallel gateway, and synchronize them with a parallel gateway before any subsequent activity that depends on all branches being complete.
rules.situation: the description says one activity can be carried out while another activity is underway

rules.instruction: When the description identifies actions or outcomes at distinct stages of a process: Label each BPMN element to reflect the action or outcome described at that stage; do not substitute a different action, a later-stage action, or an unsupported outcome.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes activities, events, or decisions at different stages of a process
